# PUT /api/v1/user/following/{username}

Follow a user

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-145`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| username | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — user is blocked by target or target is blocked by user
- **404** — target user not found

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.Follow | controller | calls user_model.FollowUser(ctx, ctx.Doer, ctx.ContextUser); handles ErrBlockedUser as 403 |
| 2 | [models](../modules/models.md) | user_model.FollowUser | repository | returns nil if user.ID == follow.ID (self-follow no-op); returns nil if already following; checks IsUserBlockedBy in both directions; within transaction: INSERT follow record, UPDATE user SET num_followers+1, UPDATE user SET num_following+1 |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Self-follow is a no-op (returns nil without error) | business_logic | user.ID == follow.ID |
| Already-following is a no-op (returns nil without error) | business_logic | IsFollowing(ctx, user.ID, follow.ID) == true |
| Blocked users cannot follow each other (bidirectional check) | authorization | IsUserBlockedBy(ctx, user, follow.ID) || IsUserBlockedBy(ctx, follow, user.ID) |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| user blocked by target or vice versa | 403 | forbidden | False |
| DB failure | 500 | internal error | True |

### Error Paths

- **target user not found** → context middleware → 404
- **user is blocked** → ctx.APIError(403) → 403
- **DB error** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500
